notes: Web-auth subscription preset (providerId 'antigravity', modelPrefixes ['antigravity'], protocol google-generative-sse on the vendor's own adapter). models lists BASE ids only; the picker shows one row per base with an effort selector, and the live list is whatever /v1internal:fetchAvailableModels returns for the ACCOUNT — measured on the daily host as 23 conversation models across gemini-4-hydrogen, gemini-4-argon, gemini-3.8-flash, gemini-3.5-flash-lite, gemini-3-flash, gemini-3.1-flash-lite, gemini-2.5-pro, claude-sonnet-5-5, claude-opus-5-5 and gpt-oss-120b (the control host returns 26 ids and no Hydrogen), so treat these three as a measured subset, not a fixed catalog. reasoning is the vendor-reported effort SUFFIX set, not a fixed enum: effort is encoded in the model id suffix because the server ignores thinkingConfig.thinkingLevel, gemini-4-hydrogen also serves xhigh, and a level the account does not serve returns 404 (an unserved level folds onto the nearest served one), so the effort list is per-model and catalog-dependent. UNVERIFIED: cache is declared false here only because the router sends no cache write/control on this wire, even though usageMetadata does report cachedContentTokenCount — cache-token REPORTING exists, cache CONTROL does not; structuredOutput is false and NOT verified as supported by this vendor endpoint (no responseSchema/responseMimeType path in the adapter); vision is true for the Gemini/Claude families, but the account also serves gpt-oss-120b with no image support, so image acceptance is per-model. Auth is a web-auth OAuth token file, never an API key; no secret is recorded in this file. The measured local reference is vendor/antigravity/docs/ANTIGRAVITY-DIRECTSDK-MEASUREMENT.md.
